title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Cola Lime Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Cola Lime blends Cola's familiar soda sweetness with a tangy Lime twist. The result is a bright, fizzy beverage-style vape where citrus sharpness cuts through smooth Cola for a refreshing finish. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod contains a 2ml pod paired with an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, giving 12ml total of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No coil replacements or refilling needed—simply attach to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. The dual mesh coil enhances flavour clarity and vapour balance for up to 6000 puffs (approx.) of consistent enjoyment. Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
